reason: 69 baht is nothing, and I like the 50/30/20 split. But the iPhone Shortcut looks like a fiddly one-time setup, and I'd only pay once it actually reads my K PLUS slips without me fixing things every time.
objection: If the Shortcut breaks or needs constant babysitting after the first week, I'll have wasted the setup time and I'll just go back to typing things in by hand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on my own K PLUS slips during the free 14-day trial, with the setup finished in a few minutes and no errors.
